collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-10  -  THE TIRED PARENT SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: A parent has spent the morning caring for a restless toddler and discovers that the family's cat has overturned its water bowl.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A parent has spent the morning caring for a restless toddler and discovers that the family's cat has overturned its water bowl.

choices.label: Ask a Trusted Family Member to Watch the Toddler Briefly.
Move the Bowl to a More Stable Place.
Admit Feeling Exhausted and Request a Short Break.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The cat drinks contentedly while the parent finally sits down.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The toddler becomes restless again, and the parent asks another adult for help.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The parent tends to the cat and returns feeling a little less overwhelmed.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The family member is busy, so the parent settles the toddler nearby before helping the cat.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The cat drinks without tipping it over again.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The new location proves inconvenient, and the parent tries a different arrangement.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: Another adult takes over for a while, allowing the parent to recover.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Help is delayed, but the parent makes a simpler plan for the afternoon.
